20261121-physics-g09-2.s.s1.prompt: If di driving speed of car for road double from 50 km/h to 100 km/h, about how many times di braking distance wey di car go slide for sudden braking go increase, in theory?
20261121-physics-g09-2.s.s1.explain: Di work wey friction do for di braking distance $s$ dey absorb di kinetic energy, so $f \cdot s = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \implies s \propto v^2$. If di speed become $2$ times, di braking distance go jump to $2^2 = 4$ times.

20261121-physics-g09-2.s.s1.hint.1: Because kinetic energy dey proportional to di square of speed, di braking distance too dey proportional to di square of speed.

20261122-physics-g10-2.material: Wetin be di science reason why OLED (organic light-emitting diode) wey dem dey use for latest smartphones and TV displays dey thinner and get better contrast ratio pass old LCD?
20261122-physics-g10-2.thinking.0: Wetin be di science reason why OLED
20261122-physics-g10-2.s.s1.prompt: Wetin be di science reason why OLED (organic light-emitting diode) wey dem dey use for latest smartphones and TV displays dey thinner and get better contrast ratio pass old LCD?
20261122-physics-g10-2.s.s1.explain: OLED dey use organic semiconductor thin film wey dey emit light by itself wen current dey flow, so thick backlight unit no necessary, and by switching off pixels e fit show perfect black and get infinite contrast ratio.
20261122-physics-g10-2.s.s1.hint.0: LCD must get backlight wey dey shine light from behind.
20261122-physics-g10-2.s.s1.hint.1: For OLED, every single pixel dey emit light by itself (self-emissive).
20261122-physics-g10-2.s.s1.o.o0: Because e dey use self-emitting organic compound elements wey dey produce light by demsef without separate backlight
20261122-physics-g10-2.s.s1.o.o1: Because OLED na liquid wey no dey use electricity at all
20261122-physics-g10-2.s.s1.o.o2: Because tens of thousands of tiny fluorescent lamps dey inside OLED
20261122-physics-g10-2.s.s1.o.o3: Because e dey use iron plate instead of glass substrate
